thread:
nina: quick heads-up — we have a batch of fncall schema rejects showing up in Console as billed tool runs. sample payload: ```json
{
  "tool_call": { "name": "geo_lookup", "args": ["lat,lng"] }
}
```

dave: can you paste the validator error?

nina: `type_mismatch at /tool_call/args: expected object got array`

lee: that makes sense; adapter never invoked. current billing path counts the root invoke and later adapter sets a tool-run tag when it runs. if adapter never runs that's misattribution.

dave: policy question: bill these or not? i lean toward no, but we need an audit-safe, deterministic rule to prevent gaming.

lee: proposal: mark these internally as `validation.outcome=reject_pre_adapter` and set `billing.tool_executed=false`. also emit `validation.rule=shape_mismatch` for sampled payloads. keep all of this under internal route.meta.* fields — no public API changes.

nina: Console UX request: show an orange state "Rejected before tool execution" with a link to a sampled payload id and brief explanation so support doesn't page.

dave: rollout plan: 1) emit internal tags + metric `validation.reject_pre_adapter.count`, 2) canary 5% traffic where billing is withheld for these rejects, 3) sample payloads for 30d, 4) monitor for abuse and billing delta for 2 weeks before full flip.

lee: implementation notes: add unit + e2e tests that simulate adapter not called and assert `billing.tool_executed=false`. cover streaming fncall and partial-parse edge cases. also add a metric `validation.reject_pre_adapter.sampled`.

nina: i'll open a Console ticket with mockups for the rejected-state card and the alert rule: if schema_reject rate spikes and billed tool-run cost increases within 1h, auto-create triage card with top routes and sample ids. tagging @console-ui for visibility. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy: starting canary `fncall-prevalidate-billhold` -> eng-runtime-canary (5%). CI: 28 tests passed, 1 infra flaky. :rocket:

dave: thanks — i'll own the PR for telemetry + tests. lee will review and add analytics hooks. nina will own Console work.
